purpose: Teach: 堅持/不均衡/商会/公訴/報い/困窮/参る/折り合い

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 当社の方針、本気で、絶対、堅持、絶対、しつつ、絶対、進めましょう
lines.en: Let's hold firm to our company's principles while we move forward.
lines.style: Measured, purposeful opening. Steady cadence, each clause landing with quiet conviction. No rush. The tone of someone speaking from genuine belief, not just reciting policy.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。業界の、本気で、絶対、不均衡、絶対、是正、絶対、当社、絶対、提言しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're actively working to address the industry's imbalances — something our company is committed to. Thank you for that.
lines.style: Attentive and earnest. Slight emphasis on the commitment. Warm but professional. Nods along with the cadence, affirming each step. Closing gratitude is genuine, not perfunctory.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 創業期の、本気で、絶対、商会、絶対、名、絶対、誇り、絶対、を持ちましょう
lines.en: We should take pride in the name we built during our founding years.
lines.style: Thoughtful pause before speaking. Slow, reflective pace. Weight on 'pride' — not boastful, but grounded. Like she's reminding herself of something true and worth keeping.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。前件の、本気で、絶対、公訴、絶対、取り下げの、絶対、可能性、絶対、出ております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. There's been real movement on dropping the charges from the previous case. We're grateful for that progress.
lines.style: Calm, factual update. Slight lift at 'real movement' — cautious optimism without overstatement. Professional warmth. Closes with genuine appreciation, not ceremony.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 長年の苦労の、本気で、絶対、報い、絶対、感じる時期、絶対、ですね
lines.en: This is the time when we truly feel that our years of effort are being rewarded.
lines.style: Quiet emotional weight. Slower pace, almost reflective. Soft on 'truly' — not dramatic, but sincere. A moment of acknowledgment, as if she's allowing herself to feel something she's carried for a long time.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。困窮、本気で、絶対、している、絶対、地域、絶対、当社の社会貢献、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're moving forward with our social contributions in the communities facing real hardship. That work continues.
lines.style: Steady, purposeful tone. Professional but not detached. Emphasis on 'real hardship' — shows the work matters to him. Closes with understated commitment, not flourish.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 重要なお取引先には、本気で、絶対、自ら、絶対、参る、絶対、よう、絶対、お願いします
lines.en: I'd like to ask that you visit our most important business partners personally.
lines.style: Clear directive, but warmly framed. Respectful 'ask' — not commanding. Steady eye-contact level. Professional courtesy with genuine regard for the person being asked.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。仕入れ先と、本気で、絶対、折り合い、絶対、つけて、絶対、契約、絶対、結びました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We've reached solid agreements with our suppliers and finalized the contracts. We're grateful for that cooperation.
lines.style: Confident, concluding note. Crisp pace on 'agreements' and 'finalized' — efficient, accomplished. Warm closing gratitude. The tone of someone reporting something well-done.
